app.name: Golf Stats Sync
app.what: Brings the data of your launch monitor from its cloud account into apps of your choice. Open source, open format.
start.failed: The app couldn't read what it keeps on this phone. Try again; if it stays like this, restart the phone.
link.invalid: That link couldn't be read, so nothing happened. Open it again from your app.
pair.title: Connect with {host}?
pair.what: From now on, your {provider} data goes to {host} whenever that app asks for it. Your sign-in stays on this phone.
pair.only: Only connect if you just tapped “connect” in that app yourself.
pair.replaces: This phone is already connected with that app: the new connection replaces the old one.
signin.title: Sign in to {provider}
signin.checkingWhy: Before anything is kept or sent anywhere, you see whose account this is.
signin.otherAccount: Careful: {targets} is connected with another account. Syncs to it stop until you sign in with that one.
signin.no: No, sign in with another account
signin.notKept: This phone's secure storage didn't take the sign-in. Try again.
signin.passkey: Passkeys can't be used in this window. Sign in with your e-mail and password; if you don't have a password yet, set one with the page's password reset.
provider.trackman.unofficial: Unofficial: Golf Stats Sync is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Trackman. It reads your own account with your own sign-in, the way Trackman's web portal does.
provider.demo.notice: Demo data: a made-up player, for trying the app out. Nothing here comes from a launch monitor.
provider.renewing: The sign-in ran out; renewing it …
provider.expired: The sign-in ran out. Sign in again to go on syncing.
signout.title: Sign out of {provider}?
signout.text: The sign-in leaves this phone. Your connections stay; syncing pauses until you sign in again.
unpair.title: Disconnect {target}?
unpair.text: {target} gets nothing more from this phone. What arrived there stays there; you can delete it in that app.
targets.title: Connected apps
targets.none: Not connected with any app yet. In the app that should get your data, choose “connect Launch Monitor Sync”; it opens this app.
targets.plan: The connected app decides when something is fetched; this app never asks the provider more than its limits allow.
sync.notPairedHow: Connect first: in the app that should get your data, choose “connect Launch Monitor Sync”.
sync.joining: Waiting for the fetch under way …
sync.back: You'll be taken back in a moment.
sync.stayed: The app that sent you here isn't one this phone is connected with, so you stay here.
first.failed: The first fetch didn’t work. The home page says why; it is tried again by itself.
demo.title: Try it out
demo.text: No launch monitor account? A made-up player shows how syncing, the counters and the log work.
log.title: Requests to the provider
log.text: Every request this app made to a provider in the last 14 days: time, kind, answer, duration. Never content.
licenses.title: Licences
licenses.intro: This app is open source (MIT) and made of {count} packages by others. Tap one for its licence.
licenses.noText: The package brings no licence text; its licence is {license}.
about.line: Golf Stats Sync {version} · MIT licence · an open-source project
run.more: more comes with the next syncs
run.busy: {at}: another device of yours is fetching
run.who.extension: the browser extension on your computer
run.who.companion: Golf Stats Sync on another phone
run.otherAccount: {at}: this sign-in is another account than the connected one
notice.guard: enough asked of the provider for now, it goes on by itself
notice.guardUntil: enough asked of the provider for now, goes on {until}
notice.unavailable: the provider isn't answering properly right now
notice.blocked: the provider can't be reached from here
counts.line: Requests today {day} of {perDay}, this hour {hour} of {perHour}
error.codeInvalid: The code has expired or was used already. Get a new one in your app.
error.targetUnreachable: The app's server can't be reached right now. Try again later.
error.providerUnknown: This app doesn't know that provider.
error.targetBusy: The app's server asks to wait a moment. Try again shortly.
error.targetOdd: The app's server answered with something unexpected.
error.guard: Enough asked of the provider for now; it goes on later by itself.
error.guardUntil: Enough asked of the provider for now; it goes on {until}.
error.guardStorage: This phone couldn't keep the request counts, so nothing was asked.
error.authRejected: The provider didn't accept the sign-in. Sign in again.
error.providerBlocked: The provider can't be reached from here. Check the connection.
error.providerUnavailable: The provider isn't answering properly right now. Try again later.
newBuild.title: A new version of this app is out
newBuild.android: It needs a new install: download it and open the file. Android asks once whether your browser may install apps – allow it. Your sign-in and connections stay.
newBuild.ios: It comes through TestFlight: with automatic updates there it arrives by itself, otherwise update it in TestFlight. Your sign-in and connections stay.
newBuild.failed: That couldn’t be opened. Try again later.
test.title: Test mode
test.what: For testing a connected app: instead of your launch monitor account, a test scenario of that app arrives – made-up data, at the pace and in the pieces it would come from the provider. The app shows the test code on its test page.
test.notice: Made-up data from a test scenario of {target}. Nothing is asked of the provider; the limits on requests hold as always.
test.notKept: This phone couldn't keep the test. Try again.
test.pairFirst: Connect with the app first: in it, choose “connect Launch Monitor Sync”. Then enter the test code again.
test.codeWrong: That test code isn't right. Check it, or get a new one in your app.
test.provider: This test is for a provider this app doesn't have.
test.until: The test runs until {until} at the latest.
test.endText: The made-up data leaves this phone and syncing to {target} pauses. What arrived there stays there; you can delete it in that app.
error.codeExpired: This test code has expired. Get a new one in your app.
error.testUnavailable: This app has no test mode.
error.notTestAccount: Test codes only work with a test account of that app. Your connection stays as it is.
error.testData: That app's account is no test account, so it takes no test data. Nothing was stored there.
error.tokenInvalid: The connection with that app has ended. Connect again in the app.
run.testData: {at}: no test data for a real account – nothing was stored
hcp.title: Handicap record (golf.de)
hcp.what: Open your record on golf.de here in the app: it reads along and sends what is new to {name}. It sends golf.de nothing of its own.
hcp.limits: Only while golf.de is open here – nothing happens in the background, and golf.de’s own app isn’t read.
hcp.other: Another golf.de account than the one {name} has connected: nothing is sent there.
hcp.seen: {seen} results seen on golf.de, {fresh} not sent yet.
hcp.waiting: Open “Mein Bereich” on golf.de once, so the app knows whose record it is.
hcp.signedOut: golf.de says you aren’t signed in there.
hcp.changed: golf.de looks different from what this version knows: nothing of it was read. Please update the app.
hcp.disconnectText: Nothing more of your handicap record goes there; what it has stays there.
hcp.pairFirst: Connect your handicap record first: in the app that should get it, choose to connect Golf Stats Sync.
pairHcp.what: From now on, the handicap record you open on golf.de here in this app goes to {host}. Your golf.de sign-in stays on this phone.
pairHcp.replaces: This phone is already connected with that app for the handicap record: the new connection replaces the old one.
golfde.hint: Sign in, then tap “Fetch all”: the app opens your History Sheet, Scoring Record and result lists for you and reads along. Sign in with e-mail and password; Google or Apple often don’t work in here.
golfde.failed: golf.de didn’t load. Check the connection and try again.
pro.how: Open your own page of the world ranking here in the app – the OWGR for men, the Rolex Rankings for women – and tap “Send” at the top. The app reads what the page shows you (your rank, points and tournaments) and sends it to {name}. It asks the site nothing of its own.
pro.pairFirst: Connect your world ranking first: in the app that should get it, choose to connect Golf Stats Sync.
pairPro.what: From now on, the pages of the world ranking and of your tour you send here in this app go to {host}: your rank, points, tournaments and their rounds.
pairPro.replaces: This phone is already connected with that app for the world ranking: the new connection replaces the old one.
rankings.choose: Which world ranking are you in?
rankings.find: Search for your name and open your own page; then “Send” appears up here.
rankings.changed: This page looks different from what the app knows: nothing of it was read. Please update the app.
rankings.failed: The page didn’t load. Check the connection and try again.
pro.unofficial: Unofficial: Golf Stats Sync is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by the OWGR, Rolex or any tour.
tours.how: Your tour: open your own profile there and tap “Send” for your rank and points; “Fetch all” opens your tournaments’ pages one by one and brings your rounds. Of each page the app takes only your own line and sends it to {name}.
tours.find: Open your own profile (search for your name in the Order of Merit); then “Send” and “Fetch all” appear up here.
